thread:
Maya (Design): quick sanity check on the rollout timeline scrubber. current proto uses a draggable playhead + micro snaps. need keyboard, screenreader, and rollback copy nailed down.
Ben (Product): agree. also want a compact label for snaps so users can skim long histories. maybe short token + tooltip.
Samir (Eng): technical constraints: can virtualize snap list, but we should cap visible snaps to avoid layout blowup. perf-wise 50 visible snaps ok with virtualization.
Lina (Accessibility): key items: keyboard focus order, aria-live for state changes, and clear labels for each snap. proposal: treat scrubber as a composite widget with role="list" and each snap role="button"; announce "Version 12, canary 10%, active" when focused.
Maya (Design): ooh I like the list/button approach. microcopy question: hover label options: "Preview v12 6% canary" vs "v12 (canary 6%)". We want short but explicit.
Ben (Product): prefer "v12 6% canary"  keeps version first and consistent with tooltips.
Chris (PM): also reword rollback CTA. Current: "Rollback to this version". Suggest: "Revert traffic to v12" so it reads like an action, not history.
Samir (Eng): backend returns job id and events. DeployBot can stream progress. UI should do a non-modal confirm then show an inline activity row with logs.
Maya (Design): mock: "Revert traffic to v12? New requests will route to v12; existing requests continue. [Cancel] [Revert traffic]". no blocking modal. focus trap while confirm visible, then focus returns to the activity row.
Lina (Accessibility): if non-modal, ensure the confirm gets aria-modal or at least manages focus. add aria-describedby that explains rollback consequences. announce start and completion in an aria-live region. also provide a keyboard shortcut to undo within 30s.
Samir (Eng): undo via a transient revert job with TTL doable. DeployBot will post: "deploy 3421: revert started" and later "deploy 3421: revert complete". We'll wire those into the timeline.
DeployBot: deploy 3421 started: reverting traffic to v12. ETA ~75s. :rocket:
Maya (Design): visual indicator ideas: small glyphs for Canary / A-B / Wave next to snaps. Also add quick filters: toggle to show only canaries.
Ben (Product): analytics: capture scrubs, snap clicks, and rollback confirmations. also track keyboard-only flows.
Lina (Accessibility): keyboard map suggestion: Left/Right = snap, Shift+Left/Right = jump major version, Space = play/pause, Home/End = start/end. document and show tooltip on first focus. ensure visible high-contrast focus styles.
Samir (Eng): will implement virtualization, aria-live hook, DeployBot streaming, and the undo window. PR aimed for next Wed.
Maya (Design): action items:
- Samir: PR with ARIA + DeployBot integration (due Wed)
- Lina: add accessibility doc snippets and announcer copy (due Fri)
- Ben/Chris: finalize microcopy for snap labels and revert CTA
- Maya: update figma with glyphs/filters and add keyboard tooltip
Ben (Product): :thumbsup:
Chris (PM): filing follow-up ticket for analytics events now.
Maya (Design): thanks all, I'll post updated screens here when done.
__notes: Design channel thread about rollout/timeline scrubber: accessibility, microcopy, non-modal rollback flow, DeployBot integration, and analytics. Kept Slack-style message brevity.
